details: The ongoing "May 2026 Hormuz crisis" has led to a significant repricing of global energy supply risk. With global oil stocks at their tightest in approximately eight years, any disruption in the critical Strait of Hormuz carries amplified price implications. Iran's potential move to permanently impose transit fees further exacerbates concerns, impacting global markets.
title: Strait of Hormuz Tensions Elevate Global Oil Price Risk

details: The Federal Reserve's Spring 2026 survey identifies geopolitical risk as the primary concern for U.S. financial stability, a significant rise from its previous ranking. The survey also notes increased concerns regarding artificial intelligence and private credit, with an oil shock now listed as the second-largest risk. Inflation and monetary policy tightening have dropped to fifth place.
title: Fed Ranks Geopolitical Risk as Top Threat to US Financial Stability

details: Michael Saylor's Strategy (MicroStrategy) disclosed a substantial net loss of $12.54 billion in the first quarter of 2026. This development, stemming from unrealized losses on its Bitcoin holdings, has introduced negative sentiment and is seen as potentially decreasing confidence in Bitcoin's price stability, influencing market trends for May 2026.
title: MicroStrategy Reports $12.5B Loss, Impacts Bitcoin Sentiment
